mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 100,000 jobs signals strengthening labor market conditions that directly boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of periods with PAYEMS growth exceeding 100,000 jobs, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) declines below 4.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates a tight labor market that accelerates consumer spending and corporate profit growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.5% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 delivers negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of triggered periods, or the Rank IC remains negative over a 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and declining consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) creates a disinflationary tightening environment that reduces equity risk premiums, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term's Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or positive return rate drops below 55% in the specified regime.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising above 1.0% for 3 consecutive months), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals imminent economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 1.0% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of triggered periods, or the Rank IC is negative over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts (HOUST) increase above 1,350,000 units signals strong consumer demand for housing, generating immediate positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through construction sector momentum.
failure_condition: S&P 500 delivers negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of triggered periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.04 over a 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 (index 2017=100) for two consecutive months indicates manufacturing sector weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as earnings pressure builds.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 95.0 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of triggered periods, or Rank IC remains negative over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year), a monthly retail sales (RSAFS) increase above 0.5% signals resilient consumer demand that offsets inflationary pressures, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 delivers negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of triggered periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 0.5% indicates robust manufacturing activity, generating immediate positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through sector momentum and earnings visibility.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 45% of periods with INDPRO growth exceeding 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.04 over a 3-year window.
